Beyond accuracy: generalization properties of
bio-plausible temporal credit assignment rules
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Beyond accuracy: generalization properties of
bio-plausible temporal credit assignment rules

extractions.description: This paper investigates the generalization capabilities of bio-plausible learning rules for recurrent neural networks (RNNs). It finds that these rules exhibit worse generalization performance compared to machine learning counterparts, correlating with higher loss landscape curvature. The study offers a theoretical explanation based on gradient alignment and supports it with numerical experiments.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on the theoretical aspects of biologically plausible learning rules and their impact on generalization in recurrent neural networks. While the findings could potentially inform the development of more efficient and robust AI systems, its direct relevance to sustainable development themes is limited.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
To our knowledge, our analysis
is the first to highlight and quantitatively provide a mechanistic
explanation of the reason for this gap in solution quality between artificial and bio-plausible learning
rules for RNNs, thereby motivating further investigations into how the brain learns solutions that
generalize.
